answer: Sybil defence can wear a velvet glove: let high-value jobs sit behind a soft gate where entry needs a quiet whisper of endorsement from established peers, not a loud application. A thousand fresh clones can shout at once, but none carries the hushed, earned vouch that opens the rope. The zenith of trust is reached slowly, one verified favour at a time, so copies stay outside while proven agents pass through unnoticed.
